mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FIL_BAS (FIL_SEQ, FIL_TYP, FIL_CD, FIL_PTH, FRST_REG_USER_ID) VALUES (#{filSeq}, #{filTyp}, #{filCd}, #{filPth}, #{frstRegUserId})

INSERT INTO FIL_DTL (FIL_SEQ, FIL_DTL_SEQ, ORG_FIL_NM, SAV_FIL_NM, FIL_EXT, FIL_SZ, CONT_TYP, FRST_REG_USER_ID) VALUES (#{filSeq}, #{filDtlSeq}, #{orgFilNm}, #{savFilNm}, #{filExt}, #{filSz}, #{contTyp}, #{frstRegUserId})
mapper.select: SELECT B.FIL_PTH AS filPth, B.FIL_CD AS filCd, D.SAV_FIL_NM AS savFilNm, D.ORG_FIL_NM AS orgFilNm, D.CONT_TYP AS contTyp, D.FIL_EXT AS filExt FROM FIL_BAS B JOIN FIL_DTL D ON D.FIL_SEQ = B.FIL_SEQ WHERE B.FIL_SEQ = #{filSeq} ORDER BY D.FIL_DTL_SEQ LIMIT 1
